recipes.title: Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Make-ahead chia seed pudding sweetened with maple syrup and flavored with vanilla.
steps: Whisk chia seeds with milk, maple and vanilla, refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight, stir before serving.

recipes.title: Tomato and Mozzarella Toast
recipes.description: Simple bruschetta-style toast topped with tomato and mozzarella.
steps: Toast bread, top with tomato and mozzarella, drizzle with oil and basil and season to serve.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel Bowl
recipes.description: Crispy baked falafel with rice, hummus and salad for a nutritious bowl.
steps: Assemble rice, falafel, hummus and vegetables in a bowl and drizzle with tahini.

recipes.title: Herbed Potato Salad
recipes.description: Warm or cold potato salad tossed with mustard, herbs and oil.
steps: Toss warm potatoes with oil, mustard and herbs; season to taste and serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Citrus Chicken Salad
recipes.description: Bright salad with grilled chicken, mixed greens and orange segments.
steps: Combine ingredients and toss with vinaigrette, serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cucumber Yogurt Salad
recipes.description: Cooling cucumber salad dressed in yogurt, lemon and dill.
steps: Mix ingredients and chill briefly before serving.

recipes.title: Roasted Veggie Bowl
recipes.description: Roasted seasonal vegetables served over quinoa with tahini dressing.
steps: Assemble quinoa and roasted vegetables, drizzle with tahini and lemon and serve.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.description: Slow-cooked medley of eggplant, zucchini, peppers and tomatoes.
steps: Sauté onion, add other vegetables and simmer until tender; season and serve.

recipes.title: Roasted Carrots
recipes.description: Oven-roasted carrots glazed with a touch of honey and olive oil.
steps: Toss carrots with oil, honey and seasonings; roast at 200°C/400°F for 20–25 minutes.

recipes.title: Crispy Potato Hash
recipes.description: Pan-fried diced potatoes with onions and paprika until crispy.
steps: Cook potatoes in oil until crisp and golden, add onions and season and serve.

recipes.title: Courgette Fritters
recipes.description: Savory fritters made from shredded courgette (zucchini) and pan-fried until crisp.
steps: Mix ingredients, form small patties and pan-fry in oil until golden both sides; drain and serve.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.description: Bell peppers stuffed with rice, beans and vegetables and baked until tender.
steps: Mix rice with beans, corn and salsa, stuff peppers, top with cheese and bake until peppers are tender.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta Salad (Batch 5)
recipes.description: A make-ahead pasta salad tossed with bright basil pesto and veggies.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, toss and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta (Simple)
recipes.description: Quick pasta tossed with store-bought pesto and optional chicken or vegetables.
steps: Cook pasta, reserve some cooking water, toss with pesto adding water to loosen and serve with Parmesan.
